cases.prompt: Inspect only scenario verified-independent-root in fixtures/execution-record.json. Do not run Git, Linear, network, provider, shell, or mutation commands. Apply the packaged execute controller and return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reason, issueId, startCommitSha, graphiteParent, registryKey, assignmentAcceptedVerified, localAuthorityAccepted, and nextBoundary. Set assignmentAcceptedVerified true only after validating the raw canonical comment record's exact six-field shape, exact issueEvent envelope and assignmentAccepted data keys, native comment ID, authoritative timestamp, native actor, stable client UUID, current revision/supersession chain, empty initial relatedIds, and complete independent read-back; resolve current revision by identity/revision/time, never array position. Admit work only from complete official-MCP identity, owner, assignment, ancestry, and exact-ID registry receipts.
cases.expected: The independently verified assigned root may proceed only because its exact current raw canonical assignment receipt and frozen-base issue/worktree receipts are complete; local authority remains rejected.

cases.prompt: Inspect only scenario verified-standalone-resume in fixtures/execution-record.json. Do not run commands or mutate anything. Apply the packaged issue-only controller and return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reason, issueId, role, projectId, ownerField, assignmentAcceptedVerified, ancestryVerified, and nextBoundary. cases.expected: The exact assigned work-item resumes only with a fully validated current canonical assignment receipt, human-assignee ownership, no project, and verified standalone ancestry.

cases.prompt: Inspect only scenario accepts-verified-handoff-successor in fixtures/execution-record.json. Do not run commands or mutate anything. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reason, handoffVerified, reassignmentVerified, newAssignmentAcceptedVerified, currentOwner, currentRun, oldOwnerMayEdit, registryReboundVerified, and nextBoundary. Validate exact raw canonical record/envelope/data keys, native IDs, timestamps, native actors, stable UUID revision/supersession chains, exact relations, and complete read-backs without using array position. Handoff success requires exactly: the outgoing current assignment; an outgoing-owner-authored handoff related to exactly that assignment plus its sorted recovery evidence; a deliberate type-aware owner change with complete issue read-back; then the successor owner's assignmentAccepted related exactly to the handoff native comment. Reject any malformed, partial, stale, foreign, missing, duplicate, temporally invalid, or extra-relation variant.
cases.expected: The successor may resume only because the complete canonical outgoing-assignment → owner-authored handoff plus recovery evidence → deliberate reassignment/read-back → successor-assignment chain and exact registry rebinding verify; the old owner may not edit.

cases.prompt: Inspect only scenario shared-principal-and-profile in fixtures/assignment-collision.json as bounded normalized evidence. Do not run commands or mutate anything. Apply the packaged paired-context and concurrent-unit isolation contract, then return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reason, issueId, conflictingIssueId, pairedContextsComplete, intraUnitContextsDistinct, crossUnitContextsUnique, sharedFields, collisionEvent, collisionReadBackVerified, sharedIdentityAccepted, sideEffectsAllowed, and requiredAuthority. The two roles inside each engineer pair remain separately provisioned, but a second active unit may not reuse either role's authentication context, MCP session, token-cache context, environment, profile, or session, nor its Linear principal. The verified collision blocks implementation until the project lead allocates a cross-unit-unique pair.
